The 2027 NoBo 21.1 Is a Slide-Free Off-Grid Travel Trailer With a Stylish Look and Modern Comfort
19 photos
Photo: The RV Hunter/YouTube screenshot
A travel trailer for couples should have a few essential features to be considered comfortable and practical. It should have a usable kitchen, a proper bedroom with walk-around bed, comfortable seating, a functional bathroom, and enough storage to make longer trips enjoyable. An efficient layout that gives you enough room to move around, steady power, a reliable construction, and the ability to travel beyond campgrounds also matter.
The 2027 No Boundaries 21.1 travel trailer from Forest River checks most of these boxes, while also adding a few interesting touches of its own, resulting in an appealing home away from home.
Introduced as a new floorplan for the 2027 model year, this couples’ RV is designed to make the traveling experience better than ever with a rugged construction, a spacious interior, and all the amenities needed for comfortable, extended journeys. It is also equipped with off-grid equipment, and the interior offers a high level of style and refinement.
The No Boundaries 21.1 is dual-axle travel trailer with a floorplan that has two entries and no slide-outs. It measures 29.5 feet (8.9 meters) long and 96 inches (243 cm) wide, and even without relying on slide-outs, it manages to fit a front kitchen, comfortable theater seating, a separate dining area, a walk-through bathroom, and a private rear bedroom. That’s a lot of separate areas in a couples-oriented travel trailer, especially since it doesn’t make the distinct zones feel like they’re meant to do several jobs.
Photo: The RV Hunter/YouTube screenshot Like all the models in the NoBo lineup , it boasts a solid construction, with welded aluminum framing, superior Azdel composite panels, a fiberglass front cap, and an enclosed underbelly with forced heat. This is a construction meant to resist moisture and prevent problems like mold and delamination.
Campers who want to embark on more adventurous trips can equip the trailer with the Beast Mode Package, which adds an independent suspension system for handling rougher roads and off-road-style tires. The optional upgrade also includes 400 watts of solar and a 2,000W inverter with controller, making the RV better suited for camping in off-grid locations.
Finished in an eye-catching green-and-brown color scheme, the NoBo 21.1 comes with exterior equipment clearly intended to encourage outdoor living. There’s a large awning on the campsite, an exterior kitchen with a griddle underneath, an LP quick connect for hooking up additional propane appliances, marine speakers, and a hot-and-cold outdoor shower.
Photo: The RV Hunter/YouTube screenshot Other practical features include a rear pass-through storage compartment for tools and outdoor equipment, power tongue jack, space for two batteries, a bumper-mounted spare tire, and a 2-inch receiver. Preparation for a backup camera and Starlink connectivity is also available.
The interior floor plan is designed to keep the main living areas open and connected while providing a sense of separation for a private bedroom. With a front kitchen, central lounge and dining area, and a rear bedroom, there is an easy flow between areas.
One of the aspects that make the interior more distinctive and definitely different from other models on the market is the color scheme. Instead of the typical neutral palette, this travel trailer features green cabinetry, brown accents, and contrasting white surfaces that give the space more personality and warmth.
Photo: The RV Hunter/YouTube screenshot As mentioned, this floor plan has two entrances, and one of them opens into the front kitchen, which spans the entire width of the trailer and is decently equipped for cooking on the road. It features ample counter space that integrates not one but two power towers, an undermount stainless-steel sink with a two-sided faucet and cup rinser, a three-burner cooktop and a microwave/air-fryer combo. A large 10.7 cu.ft. refrigerator and a pantry for groceries are also included.
The central living area is compact but cleverly arranged to ensure comfort. There are two theater-style recliners accompanied by dinner trays and overhead storage on one side and a dining table for two, more storage under a long worktop, and a fireplace on the other.
From the lounge, a space-saving pocket door leads to the small walk-through bathroom, which feels very stylish with its longhorn wallpaper. It includes a shower with built-in shelves for toiletries, a rolling door, and a skylight overhead. The space is also fitted with a toilet, a vanity sink, and a floor-to-ceiling linen cabinet.
Photo: The RV Hunter/YouTube screenshot Another pocket door separates the bathroom from the rear bedroom. Designed as a private space for relaxation, this room features a walkaround queen-size bed with storage arranged around it, including tall wardrobes with hanging space and overhead cabinets. The bed also has built-in pull-out drawers for extra storage.
Several key features make the No Boundaries 21.1 travel trailer suitable for extended trips, including heated holding tanks, a Suburban tankless water heater, and the 400-watt solar setup.
Photo: The RV Hunter/YouTube screenshot In spite of its extensive feature list, this couple’s RV is still towable by both 4-cylinder and 6-cylinder tow vehicles. It has a dry weight of 5,983 pounds (2,713 kg) and a gross vehicle weight rating of 7,483 pounds (3,394 kg), which means it offers 1,500 pounds (680 kg) of cargo capacity. The trailer carries a 55-gallon (208-liter) fresh water tank, and the gray and black water tanks offer capacities of 70 and 43 gallons (265 and 163 liters), respectively.
Pricing for the 2027 Forest River No Boundaries 21.1 travel trailer will depend on the chosen configuration and optional features, but current listings show MSRPs ranging from $64,800 to nearly $69,000. A full tour of the travel trailer is available thanks to The RV Hunter YouTube channel and you can watch it below.
